evidence.name: v3-bound
evidence.what: v3 from instance I1, the deployment bound to [I1]

evidence.name: v3-unbound
evidence.what: v3 with no instance expectation: verifies, and reports the instance it names (bound to nothing)

evidence.name: v3-restart
evidence.what: I1 after a RESTART: the same instance key, a new transport key -- still bound

evidence.name: v2-unbound
evidence.what: v2 with no instance expectation verifies exactly as before v3

evidence.name: a-other-instance
evidence.what: (a) a genuine instance I2 of the SAME app, the deployment bound to [I1]

want.reason: not one bound to the selected deployment

evidence.name: b-v2-downgrade
evidence.what: (b) v2 evidence for a deployment bound to instances

evidence.name: c-bind2-challenge
evidence.what: (c) a v3 envelope whose certificate was made over Bind2 (instanceSig consistent with that challenge)

evidence.name: d-replay-other-nonce
evidence.what: (d) a captured v3 envelope presented for another nonce

evidence.name: d-spliced-instance-sig
evidence.what: (d) a fresh v3 envelope carrying the instanceSig captured from another exchange

want.reason: instanceSig is not the instance key's signature

evidence.name: d-sig-by-transport
evidence.what: (d) instanceSig made by the transport key

want.reason: instanceSig is not the instance key's signature

evidence.name: instance-key-is-spki
evidence.what: instanceKey equal to the transport SPKI

want.reason: instance key is its transport key

evidence.name: relabelled-v2
evidence.what: a v3 envelope relabelled v2 (its v3 fields left in)

want.reason: the evidence fields must be exactly

evidence.name: appkey-v2-message
evidence.what: v3 whose appKeySig signs the v2 message (no InstanceID)

evidence.name: extra-field
evidence.what: v3 with an unknown extra field

want.reason: the evidence fields must be exactly

evidence.name: other-app
evidence.what: v3 for ANOTHER app, verified with the expected app (enrollment's rule: the entry's app)

evidence.name: empty-instance-list
evidence.what: an empty instanceIds expectation fails closed

policy.name: type1-with-instances
policy.what: type 1 carrying instances: refused by name, never read as unbound

policy.name: duplicate-instance
policy.what: one InstanceID bound to two deployments

policy.name: instances-without-v3
policy.what: instances with formats that do not allow v3

policy.name: uppercase-instance
policy.what: an InstanceID not in lowercase hex
